3. Click (37, 16): magenta at (36-37, 15-16) - moved LEFT by 1

- Click row 37 (bottom of square) → moves left
- Click row 36 (top of square when it was at 36-37) → moves up
- Click row 35 (top of square when it was at 35-36) → moves up
So the rule seems to be: click the top edge to move up, click the bottom edge to move left. Let me test clicking the right edge to see if it moves right, and the left edge to see if it moves down.
